headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.18
summary: This release works around the third 32-bit (armeabi-v7a) crash, reported against v1.6.1-modder.17: the game's arm32 libPlayFabMultiplayer.so cannot finish its static initializers inside the launcher's process, so on 32-bit devices the launcher now bypasses it entirely instead of dying in the linker. Real-device testing on 32-bit phones still decides the next step, since the maintainer has no armeabi-v7a hardware.

items.text: 32-bit testers: if your phone is 32-bit-only (for example a POCO C3) and you have Minecraft 1.26.62.1 installed from Google Play, please try the armeabi-v7a APK from this release and report in the linked issue whether the game launches — and if it does, whether multiplayer screens misbehave. The PlayFab crash you reported in #92 is bypassed here, but your device confirms it.

Worked around 32-bit (armeabi-v7a) launches of Google Play installs crashing with a native SIGSEGV inside libPlayFabMultiplayer.so's static initializers on v1.6.1-modder.17 (the same unrelocated-pointer crash as before, now inside libminecraftpe.so's own load): on 32-bit devices the launcher excludes libPlayFabMultiplayer.so from loading and rewrites libminecraftpe.so's DT_NEEDED entry in its extraction cache to drop the dependency, so the game launches with multiplayer features that depend on PlayFab degraded (issue #92).
